### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | Elsevier group-wide policy applies (journal-specific guide-for-authors page returned 403 on direct fetch, but WebSearch snippet of that same page corroborates). Generative AI/AI-assisted tools may NOT be used to create or alter images, except where AI is itself part of the research design/methods (e.g. biomedical imaging) — must then be disclosed in Methods with model name, version, manufacturer. Text-generation use by authors is allowed under Elsevier's general policy but must be disclosed; AI tools may NOT be listed as an author. Reviewers/editors are currently NOT permitted to upload manuscripts to generative AI tools during peer review (Elsevier is evaluating compliant AI tools, policy may change). This is Elsevier's standard cross-journal policy, not a Psychology of Sport and Exercise-specific variant — no PSE-specific AI clause found beyond this. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/generative-ai-policies-for-journals |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Empirical research (quantitative and qualitative), systematic reviews, meta-analyses, registered reports, protocol papers for trials, commentaries on previously published PSE work or topics of general interest to PSE readers, and reports of professional practice. Journal explicitly states openness to diverse methodological approaches (mixed-methods and qualitative work welcomed alongside quantitative).

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** High-quality empirical/quantitative studies, Qualitative inquiry, Systematic reviews, Meta-analyses, Registered reports, RCT/trial protocol papers, Professional-practice reports, Commentaries on published PSE content

- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No first-hand narrative found on 小木虫/知乎/Reddit r/AskAcademia specifically naming Psychology of Sport and Exercise reviewer behavior (tone, nitpicking style, etc.). Only a terse LetPub crowd tag ('审稿速度偏慢, 4-8周' / acceptance '较易') exists, which is a rating not a narrative — insufficient to construct a reviewer_culture claim, so left null rather than inferring from adjacent sport-psychology journals.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev shows '% immediately rejected last year' as n/a (no data submitted by respondents); no Chinese or English forum thread quotes a desk-reject percentage for this journal specifically.
- **ai_policy.gate specificity**: Could not confirm a PSE-specific AI-use passage distinct from Elsevier's boilerplate because sciencedirect.com/journal/psychology-of-sport-and-exercise/publish/guide-for-authors returned HTTP 403 on direct WebFetch; relied on WebSearch snippet of the same URL plus Elsevier's group policy page as corroboration.

- 小木虫/学术之家/爱科学/haofabiao aggregator search: no dedicated 小木虫论坛 forum thread found, but Chinese SCI-aggregator sites (xueshu.com, iikx.com, haofabiao.com) yielded consistent metadata: bimonthly, IF~3.1-3.4, JCR Q1, CAS 分区2, review speed '4-8周(约9周)', not on any warning list.
